notes: Thirteen evidence categories · founder-authored 2026-09-12. Every stored sub-claim carries EXACTLY ONE tag. Never fabricate new tags without founder ADR. Order below is presentation-only; there is no hierarchy · a claim is not 'better' for being higher in the list.

categories.definition: Strong independent historical/archaeological/documentary evidence · claim is established
Strong evidence with some remaining uncertainty
Physical archaeological evidence directly supports the claim
A tradition is documented · documentation of a tradition does not establish the underlying event as fact
categories.example: Ancient written accounts of a great flood

categories.definition: The claim belongs to religious belief · not a matter historical methods can independently settle
The claim is a cultural mythological narrative
Knowledge passed through generations · variable documentation

categories.example: Exact ramp method for the Great Pyramid

categories.definition: Evidence exists but is insufficient to settle the question

categories.example: Atlantis as a real advanced civilisation

categories.definition: A later reinterpretation of older material · not established by the ancient source itself
Available evidence substantially conflicts with the claim
categories.example: Humans and non-avian dinosaurs living together

categories.definition: NEX genuinely lacks information · honest gap · not to be conflated with UNRESOLVED (which has some evidence)
categories.example: New topic outside NEX's current registry
